content.short: Trojan is a self custodial Solana trading bot on Telegram and web, built for sniping launches, copy trading, and limit orders.
content.description: Trojan is a Solana trading platform that started as a Telegram bot and now also runs a full web terminal. It is built for speed in memecoin markets: sniping new token launches at the moment liquidity lands, copy trading wallets that have been profitable, and managing exits with limit orders and automated rules so positions do not need watching by hand. Keys stay under the user's control rather than with a custodian, and a staffed help room runs around the clock, which matters when trades are time sensitive.
